device_identity.expected: manufacturer/model/codename/release/sdk/serial are retained for the device that produced evidence

physical_android_device.expected: device is a physical Android device, not simulator or synthetic evidence

client_local_matrix_not_used_for_host_ro.expected: client-local Fit/Fill/rotation matrix is not used as host display rotation evidence

physical_host_display_rotation.expected: physical Mac display rotated through 90/180/270 with retained real-device visual and inverse-touch evidence

virtual_host_display_rotation.expected: virtual Mac display rotated through 90/180/270 with retained real-device visual and inverse-touch evidence

accessibility_tcc.expected: Accessibility grant is recorded for the signed Host bundle

bundle_identifier.expected: installed Host bundle identifier matches dev.telemachus.display

rotation_restoration_plan.expected: operator retained a restoration plan for original macOS display rotation

screen_recording_tcc.expected: Screen Recording grant is recorded for the signed Host bundle

signing_identity.expected: stable non-ad-hoc Host signing identity is available

signing_tcc_match.expected: the signed bundle identity matches the TCC rows being used

repository_current_base.expected: current-base evidence records a clean repository source revision

scope_prs.expected: related PRs #162/#243/#262/#272 are recorded in scope

source_docs.expected: README, testing guide, runbook, and Phase 1 TEST are referenced and present

client_local_fit_fill_rotation_matrix.expected: client-local Fit/Fill and Follow Mac/90/180/270 matrix stays separate from host display rotation

interpretation: A pass means the current base has retained real-device evidence for both physical and virtual macOS host displays at 90, 180, and 270 degrees. The existing client-local Fit/Fill/rotation matrix with hostRotation=0 remains supporting evidence only and cannot close this gate.
